Title: Information on: Why can indigenous people not shout at 500 decibel...
Indigenous peoples do not have any biological or cultural limitations that prevent them from producing sounds at extremely high volumes, such as 500 decibels. However, it's important to note that such intense noise levels can cause permanent hearing damage in humans and are far beyond the threshold of safe sound levels for human exposure. Therefore, it is not a matter of ethnicity but rather a question of adhering to safety standards regarding sound levels.
--- End Document 1 ---
